model.name: TRELLIS.2 Texture 2.6B
model.description: TRELLIS.2 Texture (Microsoft): PBR textures (base colour, metallic, roughness) generated for a supplied mesh from a picture of the same object. The fastest Texturer, also usable after any 3D model, but its colours only approximate the picture: SUPRA-Tex and Hunyuan3D 2.1 Paint are more faithful.
